description: Which companies this service-status pack can answer for: 190 verified Atlassian Statuspage hosts across AI and model providers, cloud and hosting, databases and observability, developer tools, payments and fintech, communications, and business SaaS. Returns the total count plus each vendor's lookup key, display name, category and status hostname, so a vendor name can be confirmed before calling statuspage_check instead of guessed. Also lists well-known companies whose status pages use a different format, together with the URL a human should open. Filter by category or search text.

category.description: Restrict to one category: ai, cloud, data, devtools, payments, comms, saas.

include_elsewhere.description: Also list known vendors that publish status in another format, with the URL to open (default false).

query.description: Substring filter over vendor key, display name and aliases, e.g. "cloud" or "git".

name: statuspage_list_vendors
title: Statuspage List Vendors
